run_note: The operator's folder was named run, copied into the snapshot ahead of the run and identical to the package. 44 model responses in 13 minutes, all from z-ai/glm-5.3 at high through OpenRouter. It wrote RELATORIO.md and achados.json at 09:37-09:38. At 09:41:34, re-checking its fix, it started PHP's built-in server with `setsid php -S ... > log 2 < /dev/null & disown`: the `2 <` (instead of `2>`) left the server's standard error on the shell tool's pipe, so opencode never returned that command and the session stopped there, with the client open. The operator noticed the stall about three and a half hours later and decided, before any judge saw the delivery, to score it as it stood, because the stall came from the agent's own command; the delivery was already complete. The operator sent nothing after the fixed first message.
